title: A file bucket must state its types
why: A bucket that omitted `types` accepted every file, HTML and executables included, only by omission. It now fails `brain check` and `brain backend serve` refuses to start, so no app stays open by accident.
steps: For each bucket B0770 reports, add the types it should hold, for example `types: ['application/pdf']`. Stored files stay as they are; only new uploads are matched.
To keep today's behaviour exactly, add `types: '*'`: it accepts any file, as the omission did, and states it.
